#### Information replicates infinitely and suffers no wear through use.  
   Unlike physical matter, digital assets and data exist in an economy of non-rivalry; consumption does not erode information, but rather refines, distributes, and elevates its systemic utility.

#### A non-recurring event requires no continuous verification.
   Terminal state changes follow immutable event-sourcing logic; once a definitive threshold is crossed (such as birth or death), redundant validation becomes pure computational waste.

#### Communication and transit infrastructure have rendered time zones obsolete.  
   Asynchronous global networks have fractured local temporal alignment, creating a world where individuals simultaneously co-exist across different temporal states—some living in the future, others in the past.

#### Time travel is to our era what atmospheric flight was to the Middle Ages.  
   Temporal displacement is not a physical impossibility, but a boundary condition defined by our current limitations in energy, physics, and instrument resolution.

#### Felix Baumgartner was the first human to experience a jerk with his unassisted body.  
   Beyond position, velocity, and acceleration lies the third derivative of position with respect to time $\left(\frac{d^3x}{dt^3}\right)$; breaking the sound barrier in freefall transformed his physical form into a direct kinematic sensor of abrupt atmospheric transitions.

#### Animals never make mistakes.  
   In natural systems, error is a non-existent concept—there is only immediate adaptation or elimination through feedback loops. "Error" is a purely human cognitive construct born from comparing reality against abstract expectations.

#### Catalepsy will cease to exist the moment we define life and death with absolute certainty.  
   Ambiguous medical states do not reflect mystical phenomena, but rather a lack of sensor resolution; once systemic biological boundaries are defined with absolute data precision, transition states collapse.

#### Every individual holds an inherent right to statelessness.  
   In a hyper-connected, cross-border digital paradigm, identity must be modular, cryptographic, and self-sovereign—rejecting the monopoly of sovereignty assigned by geographic accident.

#### Climate change and food insecurity will impact billions of people this century.  
   Geophysical instabilities and supply-chain fragilities represent systemic feedback loops that will fundamentally reorder population dynamics and global stability.

#### Bitcoin will eventually become the global currency of the planet.
In an era of arbitrary monetary expansion and systemic trust decay, an unforgeable, decentralized, and mathematically capped protocol represents the ultimate settlement layer for global trade.
